scripts.check:format: oxfmt --check .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json tsconfig.base.json tools/tsconfig.json tools/agent-issue.ts tools/agent-issue apps/server/.fallowrc.json apps/server plugins/jellyfin gen/ts/package.json
